display.purpose: Hero headlines and the largest closing statements.

headline.purpose: Numbered scene openings and manifesto headings.

body.purpose: Long-form reading at 18px or larger within a 70–74ch measure.

label.purpose: Navigation, metadata, tags and compact controls.

shadows.name: panel-deep
shadows.purpose: Conversation panel above the ink stage.

shadows.name: floating-utility
shadows.purpose: Floating share and reaction tools above the reading column.

motion.name: opening-reveal
motion.purpose: Single restrained reveal for opening copy when motion is allowed.

motion.name: image-response
motion.purpose: Small luminance and desaturation shift on story-card hover or focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Neutralizes animations and transitions under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet 44px navigation link; ember marks hover and the active route.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--text, #e9e6df); font: 600 0.9rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--naranja, #ff5e24); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7a48; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Compact bilingual switch with a pill reserved for utility controls.
components.css: .ds-language-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.3em; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.2em 0.7em; border: 1px solid var(--border, #303235); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg, #08090a); color: var(--text, #e9e6df); font: 600 0.8rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 200ms, background 200ms; } .ds-language-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--naranja, #ff5e24); background: rgba(255, 94, 36, 0.08); } .ds-language-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7a48; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Story Action
components.description: Unfilled editorial call to action; text and arrow carry the emphasis.
components.html: Leer el artículo
components.css: .ds-story-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 44px; color: #ff7a48; font: 700 1rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; } .ds-story-action svg { width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-story-action:hover { color: #ff8a5e; } .ds-story-action:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-story-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7a48; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Story Card
components.description: A flat editorial story unit separated by a hairline rather than a container.
components.html: RECABLEADO19 AGO 2026 · 6 MINUna historia contada desde dentroExperiencia real, criterio y humor sin lenguaje de ingeniero.
components.css: .ds-story-card { display: grid; gap: 0.8rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #393b3d; color: var(--text, #e9e6df); text-decoration: none; } .ds-story-card-visual { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; padding: 1.25rem; background: radial-gradient(circle at 82% 16%, rgba(255,94,36,0.16), transparent 13rem), #111315; color: #ff8a5e; font: 700 0.76rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-story-card-meta { color: #ffb093; font: 600 0.76rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-story-card strong { color: #fffdf7; font: 700 clamp(1.35rem, 2vw, 1.9rem)/1.08 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-story-card-copy { color: #c5c1b9; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Lora, Georgia, serif; } .ds-story-card:hover .ds-story-card-visual { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-story-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7a48; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Article Tag
components.description: A low-profile metadata chip over the opening image.
components.css: .ds-article-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 117, 64, 0.55); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(8, 9, 10, 0.5); color: #ffd0be; font: 600 0.8rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Scene Heading
components.description: Numbered editorial heading that marks a clean change of scene.
components.css: .ds-scene-heading { margin: 5rem 0 1.5rem; color: #fffdf7; font: 700 clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 4rem)/1.04 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-scene-heading span { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; color: #ff8a5e; font-size: 0.76rem; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Editorial Quote
components.description: Wide, centered pause in the reading rhythm with square edges and ember hairline.
components.html: ¿Esta solución funciona aunque nadie se acuerde de cumplirla?
components.css: .ds-editorial-quote { max-width: 900px; margin: 3rem auto; padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem); border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #ff5e24; border-bottom: 1px solid #303235; border-radius: 0; background: #101214; color: #fff6ee; font: 400 clamp(1.3rem, 2.5vw, 2rem)/1.45 Lora, Georgia, serif; text-align: center; }

components.name: Reaction Button
components.description: Accessible compact reaction control; active state becomes the ember.
components.css: .ds-reaction-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4em; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5em 1em; border: 1px solid #3a3c3e; border-radius: 999px; background: #17191b; color: #fffdf7; font: 600 1rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-reaction-button:hover, .ds-reaction-button:active, .ds-reaction-button[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #ff5e24; background: #ff5e24; color: #08090a; } .ds-reaction-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7a48; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Missing-image Frame
components.description: Deliberate placeholder that keeps the darkroom composition intact until a real image arrives.
components.css: .ds-image-fallback { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); background: radial-gradient(circle at 82% 16%, rgba(255, 94, 36, 0.16), transparent 13rem), #111315; color: #fffdf7; } .ds-image-fallback::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 1px; background: #ff5e24; } .ds-image-fallback span { color: #ff8a5e; font: 700 0.76rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-image-fallback strong { max-width: 22ch; font: 700 clamp(1.2rem, 1.55vw, 1.55rem)/1.05 'Bricolage Grotesque', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }

narrative.overview:
Recableado se presenta como una sala de montaje editorial: negro tinta, textura mínima y fotografías reales tratadas como fotogramas casi monocromos. El marfil sostiene la lectura y una única brasa naranja señala lo que importa sin convertir el blog en un espectáculo tecnológico.

La composición crea los cambios de plano con escala, encuadre, espacio y cortes limpios. El movimiento es excepcional y prescindible; la voz personal, el humor y el texto largo siguen siendo el producto.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-black surfaces with restrained texture and no decorative spectacle.
Near-monochrome real imagery framed like selected editorial stills.
Ivory long-form type at 18 px or larger.
Ember orange as the sole chromatic accent.
Scene-cut rhythm created by composition, spacing and rules rather than effects.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember orange is the only chromatic accent; keep imagery nearly monochrome and never introduce a competing hue.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Article body text never drops below 18 px, keeps a generous 1.78 line height and stays within about 70–74 characters.

rules.name: The Flat Stage Rule
rules.body: Content stays flat; elevation is reserved for floating tools and the chat panel, where it clarifies overlap.

dos: Do protect long-form reading with warm high-contrast text, an 18px minimum and a 70–74ch measure.
Do start from verified photographs of Giora; AI treatment may stylize the frame, but identity and authorship must stay anchored in the real source.
Do create scene changes with scale, whitespace, hairlines and composition.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, visible focus and a complete reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color, bright card palette or blue software-dashboard language.
Don't round editorial frames or turn the archive into a generic grid of floating cards.
Don't fabricate a documentary-looking hotel, room, route, device or workspace that the reader may compare with reality.
Don't add scroll-tied video, particles, trailer bands or decorative motion that competes with reading.
